title: grammatotheca bergiana var. eckloniana
intro: Grammatotheca bergiana var. eckloniana, commonly known as Berg's Grammatotheca, is a species of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
